# CallProof Vault

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: callproof-vault
Class: unwanted_call_and_text_evidence_organization
Canonical URL: https://call-proof-vault.base44.app/
Authority: public product and offer discovery with authenticated handoff for private evidence and checkout
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- organize my robocall evidence
- make an FCC complaint packet
- help me document spam calls
- prepare my FTC call evidence
- track repeated unwanted calls or texts
- build a factual unwanted-call incident timeline

## Boundaries
- CallProof is an evidence-organization tool, not a law firm and not legal advice
- it does not determine that a caller violated the TCPA or another law
- it does not automatically file an FCC or FTC complaint
- private call logs, phone numbers, notes, screenshots, voicemails and billing records are never public discovery data
- the live Stripe price attached to the selected plan is authoritative at checkout

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
